QuestInfo.name: Victor the Audiophile
QuestInfo.0: Vicky is listening to the Greatest Oldies compilation but still can't figure out exactly which song suits her. Speak to her.
QuestInfo.1: Vicky likes all the songs but can't decide which one to pick. She tells you that Victor is a classical music enthusiast and should be good at picking out a song. Classical? What does that have to do with anything? Whatever. Speak to Victor.
QuestInfo.2: You asked Victor about which song Vicky should pick.

0.0: But I still don't know what song to pick.
0.1: Now that I think about it, Victor likes to listen to old school music. He must know a thing or two about which oldies songs are good. Ask him to pick a song for me.

yes.0: I'm sure Victor won't mind. Go speak to him, he'll help you.

no.0: Well, I guess you don't wanna see the Spirit of Rock after all, huh?

1.0: You need help with choosing an Oldies song? I can help, that's all I listen to.

yes.0: Here, let me have a listen.

npc.0: I'm sure Victor won't mind. Go speak to him, he'll help you.
